management_notes: Churchill Resources management has demonstrated consistent execution through 2025-2026: maiden drill results at Black Raven/Frost Cove established high-grade antimony, the Spring 2026 program expanded the system and identified the PC Pond polymetallic discovery (final assay results released August 2026), and the team optioned the 400 sq km Golden Baie property in February-March 2026, consolidating a 30km gold-antimony trend. Two drill programs delivered within ~12 months plus a strategic land acquisition reflect coherent capital-allocation and adequate financing access. Insider ownership data is unavailable without parsing SEDI filings, which caps the score at 4 — alignment cannot be fully confirmed.
geology_notes: Black Raven Project (Central Newfoundland) hosts the Frost Cove antimony system with world-class grade intercepts: 7.25% Sb / 1.98m and 6.44% Sb / 2.06m (2025 program); 19.23% Sb / 1.40m at Frost Cove North (Spring 2026). Final assay results from the Spring 2026 program (released August 2026) confirmed a significantly expanded polymetallic vein swarm at PC Pond: 0.78% Cu and 61.2 g/t Ag over 6.22m, broadening the project's commodity optionality. The Golden Baie option adds 400 sq km and a 30km gold-antimony trend (Swanger's Cove high-grade Au-Sb prospect). No NI 43-101-compliant resource estimate has been published. Score of 3 reflects confirmed high-grade intercepts and expanded polymetallic discovery but incomplete resource delineation — grade continuity and mineable tonnage remain unproven.
capital_notes: Cap-table from April 2026 MD&A (extracted May 2026): 316,681,940 shares issued and outstanding; 342,756,940 fully diluted comprising 2,625,000 warrants and 23,450,000 options. Strike prices and expiry dates were not captured in the extraction. No flow-through tranches were detected in the filing data. The option pool (~23.5M, ~7.4% of issued) is within normal bounds for a management/director compensation program. The April 2026 data predates the Spring 2026 drill program and the Golden Baie option, both of which likely required equity financings — the actual current share count is probably higher. Score of 3 maintained pending Q3 2026 MD&A filing.
catalyst_notes: Near-term catalysts include: (1) Golden Baie exploration launch — TSXV approved the option in March/April 2026; detailed data review, systematic trenching, channel sampling, and drilling are planned for this 30km gold-antimony trend, providing a new news thread independent of Black Raven; (2) potential 2026 Q4 or 2027 drill program at Black Raven/Frost Cove targeting the expanded polymetallic vein swarm at PC Pond following the August 2026 final assay release; (3) resource estimate initiation if infill drilling supports resource geometry — no announcement yet. Macro tailwinds remain strong: China controls ~80% of global antimony supply, both Canada and the US have designated antimony a critical mineral, and defence-sector demand for flame retardants and ammunition is growing.
acquisition_notes: No NI 43-101 resource estimate precludes a formal P/NAV calculation. Strategic positioning has strengthened: (1) confirmed high-grade antimony at Frost Cove (19.23% Sb peak, multiple intercepts >4% Sb) in a western jurisdiction qualifies as a strategic critical-mineral asset; (2) Golden Baie adds 400 sq km and a 30km gold-antimony trend; (3) PC Pond Cu-Ag discovery (vein swarm confirmed expanded in August 2026 final results) introduces a polymetallic acquisition angle beyond antimony alone. Comparable transactions for pre-resource antimony assets are scarce, but western government procurement pressure and supply-chain diversification mandates are creating a buyer premium for domestic antimony. Score of 3 reflects improved strategic positioning; a resource estimate is required to move higher.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources (CRI.V) continues to advance its Black Raven antimony-polymetallic platform in Central Newfoundland. Final assay results from the Spring 2026 program, released August 2026, confirmed a significantly expanded polymetallic vein swarm at PC Pond (0.78% Cu / 61.2 g/t Ag / 6.22m) alongside established high-grade antimony intercepts at Frost Cove North (19.23% Sb / 1.40m). TSXV-approved Golden Baie option (400 sq km, 30km Au-Sb trend) is entering the exploration phase, adding a second independent news thread. The critical mineral macro tailwind is genuine — China controls ~80% of global Sb supply, and both Canada and the US have designated antimony a critical mineral. The primary gap remains a NI 43-101 resource estimate; without it, NAV cannot be calculated and acquisition value is speculative. The share structure (316.7M issued as of April 2026 MD&A) is heavy for a pre-resource junior, and the actual count is likely higher following 2026 financing activity. WATCH maintained; upgrade to BUY contingent on a resource estimate establishing mineable tonnage and grade continuity at Frost Cove/PC Pond. Cap-table sourced from April 2026 MD&A via extracted filing; resource fields empty as no NI 43-101 estimate has been published.
